description: Unofficial FairEmail 1.2337 and 1.2338 Morphe patch preview: optional Pro features, encrypted settings export, and donation banner hide. Android real-device behavior has not been tested.

patches.name: Enable local Pro features (experimental)
patches.description: Make FairEmail's local Pro feature checks return true. No purchases or signing changes. Does not preserve stock-install data across a signature mismatch.

patches.name: Enable local settings export (experimental)
patches.description: Permit the built-in encrypted account/settings export dialog. Does not grant other Pro features. Re-signed APK cannot access an existing official installation's data.

patches.name: Permanently hide donation banner
patches.description: Hide the FairEmail support/Pro message above the inbox without affecting mail, notifications, or Pro features.

release_notes: Unofficial FairEmail Morphe patch bundle. Three patches: donation banner hide (default ON), settings export (experimental OFF), local Pro checks (experimental OFF). Supports official GitHub FairEmail 1.2337a and 1.2338a only. Desktop APK patch and DEX tests passed, Android device login/export/import untested. Do not uninstall or overwrite existing official FairEmail, since signing certificates differ.
repoDescription: Unofficial FairEmail Morphe patches for 1.2337 and 1.2338 (experimental Pro and settings export)
